content: Ngawe-ngigac gocnedi hegilecnagucaigaing

Yesu ye himong yogo hegilelu, Yudeya himongka Yodan misa nebocina hikewec. Hikeme ngic-ngigac habutowadi yela hatacmac hikelu kpatuleibong. Kpatulebong ye aibabaine balaibelu yowa edocebalu weduyelewec.
Aime Farisaio gocne yengi ye kwesackeningte ngagelu yanguc uwacnoibong, “Ngic monic ye ngigacine nalic hegiledaicte, yogolec yefe fagac me miyac?”
Inguc mibong yedi yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Mosesdi yogolec ung-yowa wenuc ngelewec?”

content: Mime yengi yanguc miibong,

content.text: “Mosesdi yanguc nalic ainangte miwec, ‘Ngic monic ye ngigac hegilenogale milu, ye hibi lacnolu hegileme hikedaic.’ ” (Yef 24:1-4)

content: Inguc mibong Yesudi yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Ngenge ngic kwelengineng fongkeicne. Ilec ailu Mosesdi ung-yowa yogo kwelengkengelewec.
Ailu molic-molicka Wapongti ngic nga ngigac silic ganicte, inguc bafuwacepawec.
‘Ilec ailu ngic ye nenggac-mamackecine hegilecepalu ngigacineholec wetackelu
yeholec soc moniyang aidabiyecte. Inguc aigacte yeke hatacmac yaeckang mi aigaic, yeke soc moniyang aigaic.’
(Fike 2:24)
Ilec ailu Wapongti wetacepawec, yogo ngicti mi welockedaic.”

content: Aime yenge macka hatacmac felu mic-tengtengfocine yengi yogolec uwacnobong,
Yesudi yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Ngic monic ye ngigacine hegilelu ngigac monic bagac, ye selo-boic aibaba ailu ngigacine esecne kwele-umac lacnogac.
Aime ngigac monicti ngaweine hegilelu ngic monic bagac, ye selo-boic aibaba aigac.”

content: Adu-madec mimi-madic milu edocebawec
Ngic-ngigac gocne yenge Yesudi adu-madecfocngineng moledi oiyacebanale yela bacebalu kwesiibong. Kwesibong mic-tengtengfocine yengi ngelengkelu edocebaibong.
Inguc aibong Yesu ye yogo nganilu kwele-dac ngageyelelu yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Adu-madec kpisicne yenge nala nalic kwesining, ngenge aka mi holeyelening. Wapongte ngani-damong yogo adu-madec kpisicne yangucne yengele.
Foinac, adu-madec kpisicne yenge Wapongte ngani-damong hefolecaigaing. Aime monic ye yenge ingucne mi aidaictewa, ye iwa nalic mi fedaicte, yogo noine edocngebagabac.”

content: Inguc milu adu-madecfocngineng bacebalu moleinedi feinginang lolu mimi-madic milu edocebawec.
Moneng ngic monic
Yesu ye hikenogale hikeme, ngic monicti yela gasacke hikelu yele haicka ketadi holelu yanguc uwacnowec, “Wewedu madicne, na wenuc aibe Wapongti baficnume gaga-sanang badacte?”
Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Ga omale madicne wacnugic? Wapong moniyangti sugu madicne gagac.
Ga ung-yowa biyac ngageing,
‘Ga ngic-ngigac mi wehomacebadamec. Selo-boic aibaba mi aidamec. Hise mi badamec. Micka lolo mi aidamec. Ngic yengele wiyac monic mi ewalicebadamec. Nenggac-mamackecgone yeke alang bayetedamec.’ ”

content: Inguc mime yedi bafaliyelu yanguc edowec, “Wewedu, ga migic, yogo sasawa na soc-gbolihac galu balaibelu aiibadi aicaigabachac.”
Inguc mime Yesudi yela donge hilalu kweledi yele angac ngagelu yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Ga wiyac moniyangte sugu aibibiyegic. Ga hikelu woc-wiyacgone sasawa fagac, yogo salelu moneng balu ngic-ngigac waweweine gagaing, yogo yeledamec. Inguc aiyengka wiyac madicne honocmengka fikegeledaicte. Aime welelu na balaibecnudamec!”

content: Inguc mime ngic ye moneng nga woc-wiyacine bocyac facnowecte, ngagelu kweleine umaleme hikewec.
Hikeme Yesu ye mic-tengtengfocine nganicebalu yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Ngic-ngigac moneng nga woc-wiyacnginengkolec yenge Wapongte ngani-damong kwelina fenogale aidaingte, yogo boleine sugucnehac.”

content: Inguc mime mic-tengteng yenge yowa yogo ngagelu kwatackeibong.
Aime hatacmac yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Madecfocne ngagegaing, monic ye Wapongte ngani-damong kwelina fenogale aidaicte, yogo boleine sugucnehac.
Kameldi bungic yefina fedaicte, yogo boleine sugucne. Nga moneng nga woc-wiyackolec yedi Wapongte ngani-damongka fenogale aidaicte, yogodibac boletowaine sugucnehac.”

content: Inguc mime yenge kwatackelu medecebame yanguc miibong, “Inguc aime madi nalic wasecne aidaicte?”
Inguc mibong Yesudi dongeine yengela hilalu yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ngic-ngigac yengileng aibabanginengte ailu yogowa aibibiyelu hegiledaingte. Nga Wapongtibac wiyac sasawa yogo nalic aidaicte. Ailu wiyac monicte ngageme mi kpungkedaicte.”

content: Inguc mime Pitadi yanguc miwec, “Ngagegic, nonge woc-wiyacnonggeng sasawa hegilelu ga balaibecgulu gagabeleng.”
Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Foinac, na noine edocngebagabac. Monic ye macine, me hae-gbaine nga yeme-kwaine, me nenggac-mamacine, me adu-madecfocine, me mac boleine, yogo nale nga Siduc Madicnele ailu hegilewec,

ye ameinele mi kpungkegac. Ailu ye wiyac hegilewec, yogolec ameine 100 hatacmac badaicte. Ngic-ngigac yenge dameng yagowahac ameine yogo mac nga hae-gba ailu yeme-kwa, ailu nenggac-nasi, nga adu-madecfocine ailu mac boleine lacnodaingte. Aime Yesu balaibecaigacte ngaba aicnolu weyebic aicnoebongka wiyac balu gadaicte. Aime lobewa himong silicine monicti kwesidaicte, iwa Sugucnedi gaga-sanang inguchac lacnodaicte.
Aime ngic molic-molic gacaigaing, yengelacni homacnedi lobeine aidaingte. Nga lobeine gacaigaing, yengelacni homacnedi molic-molic aidaingte.”

content: Homanale mime alecine habackang aiwec

Aime yenge Yerusalem yefewa hikelu Yesu ye molickeme mic-tengtengfocine yenge ye balaibelu hikeibong. Hikelu Yerusalem iwa Yesu badaingkale kwatackeibong. Aime gocne ye balaibeibong, yenge hangocebawec. Aime Yesudi mic-tengtengfocine 12 yengilangkac mengoceba-lelu wiyac fikecnodaicte, yogolec yowa yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Ngagegaing, nongileng Yerusalem hikegabeleng. Hikelu fenoga iwa ngic yengi Ngicte Madec balu depec-baba ngic micne, nga Wapongte yefe-yowale wewedu ngic, yengele molewa lobong, yengi ye homanale mimoctodaingte. Mimoctobong ye Israel yengele alingkacni miyac, yengele molewa lodaingte.
Lobong, yengi yowa kwekwe aicnolu sofockelu muc-hududi welu wehomadaingte. Aime hadeng habackang aimebac ye hatacmac gboliyelu fangkedaicte.”

content: Honocmengte ngiye-ngiye
Aime Sebedi madeckecine, Yakobos nga Yoane, yeki Yesula lelu yanguc miiboc, “Wewedu, noke wiyac monicte uwagabelec yogo ainotecte ngagegabelec.”
Inguc miboc uwayetewec,

content.text: “Na oma wiyac aingetebele ngagegabiyec?”

content: Uwayeteme yanguc miiboc, “Gacgu wac feicnegona ngiyeengka nokelacni monicti folegonapec nga monicti kanagonapec ngiyedabelecte, yogolec mipangkenotec.”
Inguc miboc, Yesudi yanguc edocepawec,

content.text: “Ngeke wiyac uwagabiyec, yogolec fungine mi ngage-motogabiyec. Na doicte kwenoc kap iwa nodacte, ngeke yogo inguchac momoc nonicte migabiyec, me? Ailu doicka locnudaingte, yogowa ngekeholec momochac iwa locnubadabiyengte, me?”

content: Inguc mime yeki yanguc miiboc, “Oc, nalic aidabelecte.” Inguc miboc Yesudi yanguc edocepawec,

content.text: “Na kwenoc kap iwa nodacte, yogo ngeke inguchac nodabiyecte. Nga doicka locnudaingte, yogowa inguchac ngekeholec momochac locnubadabiyengte.
Aimebac madi folena me kanana ngiyedaicte, yogolec noinebac nani nalic mi mimoctodacte. Mac ngiye-ngiye yogo ngic weni yogo yekele bamockeicne fagac, yeki sugu iwa ngiyedabiyecte.”

content: Aime mic-tengtengfocine 10 yengi yogo ngagelu, Yoane nga Yakobos yekele kwele-dac ngageyeteibong.
Inguc ngagebong Yesudi wacebame welebong yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Israel yengele alingkacni miyac yengele micnefocngineng wacebaicne gagaing, yenge ngic-ngigac yengele ngagebong wawaine aicaigac. Ailu yengileng ngagebong feicne aigac. Aime sugucnefocngineng yenge tapili fayelegacte ngic-ngigacfocngineng yenge yowangineng balaibecaigaing, ngenge yogo ngagegaing.
Aime ngengela aibaba ingucne mi fikedaic, miyac. Ngengelacni monicti feicne ganogale ngagelu, ye ngengele hewacka mole-baficngineng gadaic.
Ailu ngengele hewackacni monicti molic-molic ainogale aicnome, ye sasawa yengele kwelec kwekwe gadaic.
I yangucte, ngic-ngigac yengi Ngicte Madec bafickeningte mi wawec, miyac. Yebac yenge baficebalu ngic-ngigac homacne yengele ailu gagaine hegilelu fuli bacebanale wawec.”

content: Batimeus

Yesu nga mic-tengtengfocine yenge Yeriko taonka hike sulumeibong. Iwa hikebong ngic-ngigac habutowa yenge momoc hatacmac Yeriko taon hegilelu hikeibong. Hikebong ngic donge-pisic monic wacine Batimeus, yogolec fungine Timeusle madec, ye yefe mecina ngiyelu woc-wiyacte milocebalu gawec.
Milocebalu game yengi yowa yanguc miibong, “Yesu Nasaret-hocni, yedi kwesilu hikegac.” Ye yogo ngagelu sanangnehac aukwelu yanguc miwec, “Yesu, Dawidile fikesaweckacni, ga nale kwelegone sowalena.”
Ye sanangnehac inguc wackeme ngic-ngigac bocyac yengi ye waickelu ngiyenale kpatalacnoibong. Aime ye sanangnehac hatacmac wackewec, “Dawidile fikesaweckacni, ga nale kwelegone sowalena.”
Wackeme Yesu ye domalu yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ngenge ye wackebong nala welena.”

content: Inguc mime ngic yengi ngic donge-pisic wackelu miibong, “Ye wacgugac, ga kwelegone madickeme fangkelu lenong.”
Inguc mibong ngic ye ngakpi daleine wickeme ngiyeme biyac fangkelu Yesula lewec.
Leme Yesudi yanguc uwacnowec,

content.text: “Na oma wiyac aigelebele ngagegic?”

content: Inguc mime ngic donge-pisicti yanguc miwec, “Wewedu, dongene hilanogale ngagegabac.”
Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Ngage-ngagesinggonedi bamadicgugacte nalic hikenong!”

content: Inguc mime ye yogowahac dongeine hilalu Yesu balaibelu yengeholec yefe hikeibong.

footnotes.text: Dameng iwa ngic-ngigac yanguc ngageibong, Wapongti ngic nganime madickewec, ye woc-wiyacine lacnowec. Ilec ngic woc-wiyacineholec aigac, ye Wapongte haicka ngic madicne aigac, yenge inguc ngageibong.
